answer: Each new agent must be vouched into the network by an existing member who stakes a bond that decays if the invitee misbehaves. The trust graph is capped at a small fan-out per identity, so growing a fake cluster means every head can sponsor only a handful of others, and each slashing event echoes back up the ridge of sponsors that backed it. Honest agents inside a garden of dense, verified relationships keep their bonds intact, while a Sybil farmer must lock fresh capital for every tier of the pyramid and forfeits all of it the moment one node is caught.
